description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - Notify the First Meeting of Haldummulla P/S and 15 other Local Govt. Bodies
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the schedule for the first meetings to nominate Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Deputy Chairmen for Local Government Institutions in Uva Province. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, specifically the nomination and inauguration procedures for elected local government officials, making it an Elections Gazette.
